question: Do signed native, orthogonal/PCA or bounded sparse dictionaries provide stable, selective and function-preserving early-block features?
evidence_class: Exploratory held-out-source geometry, point-forecast reconstruction interventions and saved-only paired-response audit; no monosemanticity claim
interpretation: PCA is a strong no-SAE compression baseline. At k16 it beats the seed-mean learned models on global state reconstruction and mean point-forecast distortion in both models; per-domain outcomes and k8 differ.

Full-state NMSE is not weak-response preservation. Direct central differences show substantial residual error, even when static offsets cancel. At k16 PCA and nested have similar Bolt sinusoid-response error; TimesFM sinusoid errors are similar across PCA/TopK/nested, while PCA better preserves noise responses.

No causal monosemanticity/usefulness verdict: invalid/fallback random controls are unscorable, natural-input reach does not certify selected-edit reach, and independent +/- random edits are not calibrated smooth-response nulls.
Zero output effect does not imply a zero activation edit. Base edit replay is exactly bound to native states; cached +/- edits cannot certify fresh singleton branch edits.
Static position-conditioned FIT means explain part of the global compression baseline, especially Bolt, but cannot explain all PCA gains or preserve input-dependent responses.
Seed-direction stability is modest and few-feature predictive selectivity depends on representation, budget, metadata and seed. Decodability can survive random initialization (PM35).
controls: FIT-only center/scalar, PCA, dictionaries, probe selection and metadata residualization; equal source weighting; TEST holdout
Signed native versus orthogonal controls; budgets1/4; k8/16; three learned/rotation seeds; actual L0 matched on full and audited +/- tokens
Exact native singleton self/repeat/saved-state and natural counterfactual replay; source-specific random validity retained
Nuisance/noise, background/domain and phase slices; raw and model-normalized coefficient targets; input and normalizer metadata controls
limitations: Spectral reused cache; four independent TEST real sources/domain. Native subset has four synthetic receivers; state/response audits have16 synthetic TEST sources.
No fresh crossed injected phase, no random-initialized native control, no FFN neuron result; those axes are not inferred from residual coordinates.
Nested is Matryoshka-inspired global TopK with two prefix losses, no AuxK/temporal/forecast consistency; 1.25x dense forward matmul FLOPs versus TopK at equal parameters/steps.
PCA stores a fitted d-by-d basis; zero optimizer parameters is not zero fitted capacity. No equal-compute claim across direct and neural fits.
Posthoc validity and response audits are diagnostic; preservation of native behavior is not correctness of known signal semantics or forecast improvement.
Earlier conservative-null wording is superseded by interpretation_corrections.json and validity_audit/knowledge.json.
PCA uses a FIT-frozen full orthogonal basis with input-dependent magnitude-top-k coefficients; it is not a fixed rank-k projection.
